A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities so the fractional parts are in a compatible form for subtraction, including finding a common denominator or rewriting a whole number as a number with a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align with a mixed number or fraction.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are explicitly rewritten into matching denominator form before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2; that is S02.
Do not tag the actual subtraction after forms are aligned; that is S03.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is rewritten as an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly carries extra wholes from an improper fractional part into the whole-number part before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion of proper fractions; that is S01.
Do not tag borrowing during subtraction after a negative fractional difference appears; that is S04.
Do not tag combining final whole and fractional parts into the answer unless it is part of the normalization itself.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Perform the subtraction once forms are compatible, either by subtracting numerators of like fractions or by subtracting whole parts and fractional parts separately.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted for fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when whole-number parts and fractional parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when a whole-number result and a zero fractional result are obtained directly from subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create common denominators or rewrite wholes with 0 fractional parts; that is S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that is S02.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional part appears; that is S04.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing 1 when the fractional subtraction is negative, and/or reduce the resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms and final mixed-number or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole part and converted into denominator-over-denominator to continue subtraction.
Tag when a fraction result is simplified to lowest terms, including reducing to 0 or to an integer.
Tag when the final simplified mixed number or integer is formed after regrouping or reduction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction that does not involve regrouping or simplification; that is S03.
Do not tag initial denominator alignment or rewriting of wholes; that is S01.
Do not tag conversion of improper mixed numbers before subtraction; that is S02.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Make fractional parts comparable by identifying a common denominator and rewriting fractions as equivalent fractions when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a solution converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction when only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of creating comparable fractional parts with an explicit denominator already in use.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps.

skills.name: Normalize number form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a usable subtraction form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a mixed number with zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align with mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts for setup.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag common-denominator conversion alone.
Do not tag the actual subtraction of whole or fractional parts once the form is already set.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract quantities once they are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers or mixed/whole combinations.
Tag when the solution combines the resulting whole and fractional parts into the final value.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create a common denominator.
Do not tag normalization steps such as rewriting 3 as 3 + 0/5 or converting 1 4/3 to 2 1/3.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps where a whole is traded for fractional units.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve negative fractional parts by borrowing from the whole part and reduce the resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution borrows 1 from the whole part to continue subtraction of fractional parts.
Tag when a solution rewrites 1 whole as d/d and adds it to the fractional part.
Tag when a solution simplifies a fraction, reduces 0/d to 0, or expresses the final result in lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction that does not require regrouping or simplification.
Do not tag finding a common denominator before subtraction.
Do not tag initial normalization of whole numbers or improper mixed numbers.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Make fractional parts comparable by identifying a common denominator and rewriting fractions, including rewriting a whole number as a quantity with 0 over the needed denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align fraction parts for subtraction.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are rewritten into equivalent fractions before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag mere classification statements such as 'Type C' or 'Type E' unless an actual denominator-alignment rewrite occurs.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number into a standard mixed number unless it also includes denominator equalization.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract once quantities are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and/or subtracting whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of fractions with a common denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole-number parts of mixed numbers.
Tag when the solution subtracts fraction parts of mixed numbers after they are already aligned.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create a common denominator or rewrite a whole number with 0 over a denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust the whole and fractional parts after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Regroup or normalize
skills.definition: Restructure a number before or during subtraction by normalizing a mixed number with an improper fraction part or by borrowing/regrouping 1 whole into fractional units.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 is rewritten as a standard mixed number.
Tag when 1 whole is borrowed from the whole part and converted into denominator-sized fractional units.
Tag when regrouping is used because the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that do not change the representation of the numbers.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion unless it is part of an explicit borrow/regroup action.
Do not tag final combining or simplification steps.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or a whole-plus-zero-fraction result is simplified to an integer.
Tag when the solution combines whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or integer form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself unless the step also explicitly performs simplification or final-form combination.
Do not tag denominator equalization or borrowing steps.
Do not tag intermediate unsimplified results that are not yet reduced or expressed as the final answer.
